recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: solar outpacing every other power source in utah for the first time
the rhine at record low, europe's rivers running thin in drought
devtools discourse turning toward open source
clear august morning in san francisco, sixteen degrees and still
summer daylight stretching past eight on the bay

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling solar photons with a drifting collector and light up a neighborhood grid tile by tile before sunset.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: powering one full city block in under a minute feels like flipping a switch on the whole skyline
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: sun angle shifts, photons fall faster and from wider angles, shadows creep across panels

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap in rhythm with tide pulses to hop across exposed river stones before the drought-swollen current pulls them under.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: crossing the river in one breathless 45-second run
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: stones sink faster, beats syncopate, water level drops mid-crossing
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: cracked clay watercolor with muted blues

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw irrigation channels from a shrinking alpine stream to thirsty fields, routing water before evaporation wins.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: saving three plots before the channel runs dry
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: evaporation accelerates, longer channels crack and leak, terrain slopes shift
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: topographic paper cutout with ink-wash edges

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick agent tokens into parallel task lanes on a phone screen, matching each bot to the right queue before the sunrise ship deadline.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clearing the morning agent backlog in one thumb session
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more agent types appear, lanes narrow, sunrise timer compresses
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon terminal glow through foggy glass
